physical_source: Constrained AC OPF parent, normalized diagonal OpenDSS fixed-PQ replay
checkpoint_selection: Maximum validation phase recall at validation healthy 99th percentile; tie-break non-phase trigger rate then validation loss
primary_test_model: Best seed/epoch selected before calibration and test inference
calibration: Independent healthy calibration parents; strict score > upper empirical 99th percentile
uncertainty: 1000 physical-parent bootstrap replicates; zero-event limitations disclosed
scope: Physical simulation benchmark; no field-data, arcing-HIF, harmonic, dynamic recovery, or cross-system claim
test_policy: Do not tune model/hyperparameters/thresholds after inspecting final test scores
